mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ocean_gis.gis_vector_layer (id, data_set_id, source_file_id, layer_key, layer_name, group_id, original_group_id, geometry_type, assignment_mode, enabled, style_mode) VALUES (#{l.id}, #{l.dataSetId}, #{l.sourceFileId}, #{l.layerKey}, #{l.layerName}, #{l.groupId}, #{l.originalGroupId}, #{l.geometryType}, #{l.assignmentMode}, #{l.enabled}, #{l.styleMode})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ocean_gis.gis_vector_layer WHERE source_file_id = #{fileId} AND layer_status = 'IMPORTING'
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ocean_gis.gis_vector_layer l WHERE l.source_file_id = #{fileId} AND l.deleted = 0 ORDER BY l.id
mapper.update: UPDATE ocean_gis.gis_vector_layer SET layer_status = #{status}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ocean_gis.gis_vector_layer l JOIN ocean_gis.gis_data_set ds ON ds.id = l.data_set_id AND ds.deleted = 0 WHERE l.id = #{id} AND l.deleted = 0 AND l.layer_status = 'READY'
SELECT FROM ocean_gis.gis_vector_layer l JOIN ocean_gis.gis_data_set ds ON ds.id = l.data_set_id AND ds.deleted = 0 WHERE l.id = #{id} AND l.deleted = 0 AND l.layer_status = 'READY' FOR UPDATE OF l
mapper.update: UPDATE ocean_gis.gis_vector_layer l SET feature_count = s.total, geographic_extent = CASE WHEN s.total = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ST_SetSRID(s.bounds::geometry,4326) END, geometry_types = COALESCE(s.types, '[]'::jsonb), data_version = l.data_version + 1, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM (SELECT count(*) AS total, ST_Extent(geom) AS bounds, jsonb_agg(DISTINCT GeometryType(geom) ORDER BY GeometryType(geom)) AS types FROM ocean_gis.gis_vector_feature WHERE layer_id = #{id} AND deleted = 0) s WHERE l.id = #{id} AND l.deleted = 0
UPDATE ocean_gis.gis_vector_layer SET deleted = 1, source_file_id = NULL, data_version = data_version + 1, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0

SELECT FROM ocean_gis.gis_vector_dataset_style s JOIN ocean_gis.gis_data_set ds ON ds.id=s.data_set_id AND ds.deleted=0 AND ds.category_id=2 WHERE s.data_set_id=#{dataSetId} FOR UPDATE OF s

SELECT g.*,count(l.id) AS layer_count,COALESCE(sum(l.feature_count),0)::bigint AS feature_count FROM ocean_gis.gis_vector_group g LEFT JOIN ocean_gis.gis_vector_layer l ON l.group_id=g.id AND l.data_set_id=g.data_set_id AND l.deleted=0 AND l.layer_status='READY' WHERE g.data_set_id=#{dataSetId} GROUP BY g.id ORDER BY g.sort_order,g.id
SELECT * FROM ocean_gis.gis_vector_group WHERE data_set_id=#{dataSetId} AND id=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE ocean_gis.gis_vector_dataset_style SET data_revision=data_revision+CASE WHEN #{data} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, display_revision=display_revision+CASE WHEN #{display} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE data_set_id=#{dataSetId}

UPDATE ocean_gis.gis_vector_layer SET group_id=#{l.groupId},assignment_mode=#{l.assignmentMode}, enabled=#{l.enabled},style_mode=#{l.styleMode},presentation_version=presentation_version+1, update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{l.id} AND presentation_version=#{expected} AND deleted=0 AND layer_status='READY'
mapper.select: SELECT s.id,s.layer_id,s.name,s.is_default, CASE WHEN sum(octet_length(s.definition::text)) OVER() <= 1048576 THEN s.definition::text END AS definition_json,s.version FROM ocean_gis.gis_vector_style s JOIN ocean_gis.gis_vector_layer l ON l.id=s.layer_id WHERE l.data_set_id=#{dataSetId} AND l.deleted=0 AND l.layer_status='READY' AND l.enabled AND l.style_mode='CUSTOM' AND s.is_default AND l.id IN #{id}
mapper.sql:
WITH settings AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT 40075016.68557849/(power(2.0,#{ctx.displayZoom})*256.0) AS resolution, CAST(#{policyJson} AS jsonb) AS policy, ST_Transform(
ST_MakeEnvelope(#{ctx.bbox[0]},#{ctx.bbox[1]},#{ctx.bbox[2]},#{ctx.bbox[3]},4326)
ST_Collect(ST_MakeEnvelope(#{ctx.bbox[0]},#{ctx.bbox[1]},180,#{ctx.bbox[3]},4326), ST_MakeEnvelope(-180,#{ctx.bbox[1]},#{ctx.bbox[2]},#{ctx.bbox[3]},4326))
,3857) AS view_box, ST_MakeEnvelope(-180,-85.0511287798066,180,85.0511287798066,4326) AS world_geo ), plans AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT p AS plan,(p->>'layerId')::bigint AS layer_id,(p->>'groupId')::bigint AS group_id FROM jsonb_array_elements(CAST(#{plansJson} AS jsonb)) p ), matched AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT f.id,f.layer_id,f.properties,f.geom,p.group_id,p.plan,r.rule FROM plans p JOIN ocean_gis.gis_vector_feature f ON f.layer_id=p.layer_id AND f.deleted=0 CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT r.value AS rule FROM jsonb_array_elements(p.plan->'rules') WITH ORDINALITY r(value,seq) WHERE ocean_gis.vector_filter_matches(f.properties,r.value->'filter',(p.plan->>'normalized')::boolean) AND (NOT (p.plan->>'zoomBeforeMatch')::boolean OR ((r.value->>'minZoom' IS NULL OR #{ctx.displayZoom} >= (r.value->>'minZoom')::double precision) AND (r.value->>'maxZoom' IS NULL OR #{ctx.displayZoom} < (r.value->>'maxZoom')::double precision))) ORDER BY seq LIMIT 1 ) r WHERE
f.geom && ST_MakeEnvelope(#{ctx.bbox[0]},#{ctx.bbox[1]},#{ctx.bbox[2]},#{ctx.bbox[3]},4326) AND ST_Intersects(f.geom,ST_MakeEnvelope(#{ctx.bbox[0]},#{ctx.bbox[1]},#{ctx.bbox[2]},#{ctx.bbox[3]},4326))
(ST_Intersects(f.geom,ST_MakeEnvelope(#{ctx.bbox[0]},#{ctx.bbox[1]},180,#{ctx.bbox[3]},4326)) OR ST_Intersects(f.geom,ST_MakeEnvelope(-180,#{ctx.bbox[1]},#{ctx.bbox[2]},#{ctx.bbox[3]},4326)))
AND COALESCE((r.rule->>'visible')::boolean,true) AND (r.rule->>'minZoom' IS NULL OR #{ctx.displayZoom} >= (r.rule->>'minZoom')::double precision) AND (r.rule->>'maxZoom' IS NULL OR #{ctx.displayZoom} < (r.rule->>'maxZoom')::double precision) ), projected AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT m.*,s.resolution,s.policy,ST_CollectionExtract( ST_Intersection(ST_Transform(ST_Intersection(ST_Force2D(m.geom),s.world_geo),3857),s.view_box), CASE m.plan->>'kind' WHEN 'POINT' THEN 1 WHEN 'LINE' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END) AS display_geom FROM matched m CROSS JOIN settings s ), filtered AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT *,ST_PointOnSurface(display_geom) AS anchor, (#{ctx.forceAggregation} OR (plan->>'gridRequired')::boolean) AS clustered FROM projected WHERE NOT ST_IsEmpty(display_geom) AND (plan->>'kind'!='POLYGON' OR (plan->>'pixelExempt')::boolean OR ST_Area(display_geom)/(resolution*resolution) >= (policy->'pixelFilters'->>'polygonMinAreaPixels')::double precision) AND (plan->>'kind'!='LINE' OR ST_Length(display_geom)/resolution >= (policy->'pixelFilters'->>'lineMinProjectedLengthPixels')::double precision) ), cells AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT *,floor((ST_X(anchor)+20037508.342789244)/(#{ctx.gridPixels}*resolution))::bigint AS cell_x, floor((ST_Y(anchor)+20037508.342789244)/(#{ctx.gridPixels}*resolution))::bigint AS cell_y FROM filtered )

, objects AS ( SELECT 'f:' || id::text AS representation_id,NULL::text AS cluster_id, id::text AS feature_id,layer_id::text AS layer_id,group_id::text AS group_id, rule->>'id' AS rule_id,rule->'symbol' AS symbol,plan->>'kind' AS category, CASE WHEN (plan->'labels'->>'enabled')::boolean AND #{ctx.displayZoom} >= (plan->'labels'->>'minZoom')::double precision THEN left(COALESCE(properties->>(plan->'labels'->>'field'),properties->>(plan->'labels'->>'fallbackField')),200) END AS label, (plan->>'renderOrder')::integer AS render_order,1::bigint AS feature_count, CASE WHEN plan->>'kind'='POINT' THEN display_geom ELSE ST_SimplifyPreserveTopology(display_geom,resolution*(policy->'generalization'->>'maxErrorPixels')::double precision) END AS display_geom FROM cells WHERE NOT clustered UNION ALL SELECT 'g:' || group_id || ':' || cell_x || ':' || cell_y, group_id || ':' || cell_x || ':' || cell_y,NULL,NULL,group_id::text, (array_agg(rule->>'id' ORDER BY id))[1], (array_agg(rule->'symbol' ORDER BY id))[1],'POINT',NULL, min((plan->>'renderOrder')::integer),count(*), ST_Centroid(ST_Collect(anchor)) FROM cells WHERE clustered GROUP BY group_id,cell_x,cell_y )
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM cells WHERE NOT clustered) + (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT group_id,cell_x,cell_y FROM cells WHERE clustered GROUP BY group_id,cell_x,cell_y) c)

, labeled AS ( SELECT *,row_number() OVER(ORDER BY CASE WHEN label IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,render_order,representation_id) AS label_rank FROM objects ) , encoded AS ( SELECT o.representation_id AS "_vector_representation_id",o.cluster_id AS "_vector_cluster_id", o.feature_id AS "_vector_feature_id",o.layer_id AS "_vector_layer_id",o.group_id AS "_vector_group_id", o.rule_id AS "_vector_rule_id", CASE WHEN o.cluster_id IS NULL THEN o.symbol::text ELSE jsonb_build_object( 'color',COALESCE(o.symbol->>'color',o.symbol->>'fillColor'), 'radius',least(12,COALESCE((o.symbol->>'radius')::double precision,5)+CASE WHEN o.feature_count>1 THEN log(2,o.feature_count::numeric)::double precision ELSE 0 END), 'opacity',COALESCE((o.symbol->>'opacity')::double precision,0.85))::text END AS "_vector_symbol", o.category AS "_vector_category",o.feature_count AS "_vector_feature_count", CASE WHEN o.label_rank <= ceil((#{ctx.widthPixels}::double precision*#{ctx.heightPixels})/ (CAST(#{policyJson} AS jsonb)->'labels'->>'pixelsPerLabel')::double precision) THEN o.label END AS "_vector_label", o.render_order AS "_vector_render_order",g.geom FROM labeled o CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT ST_AsMVTGeom(o.display_geom,ST_TileEnvelope(#{z},#{x},#{y}),4096,0,true) AS geom OFFSET 0 ) g WHERE NOT ST_IsEmpty(g.geom) ), tile AS ( SELECT COALESCE(ST_AsMVT(encoded,'features',4096,'geom'),''::bytea) AS body FROM encoded ) SELECT CASE WHEN octet_length(body) <= #{maxBytes} THEN body END AS body,octet_length(body)::bigint AS byte_size FROM tile
